analysis.title: Americas Transportation: Railroads: Weekly Rail Carload Snapshot — Week 43
key_insights: US Class I rails under coverage (UNP, NSC, CSX) show total carload growth of +6.5% YoY in week 43, down from +7.5% in week 42.
US intermodal volume growth was +8.0% YoY in week 43, down from +11.8% (cited as +12%) in week 42. US ex-intermodal growth was +5.1% YoY, up from +3.2%.
In week 43, UNP had the highest US intermodal growth at +17.1% YoY (NSC +9.4%, CSX -4.7%). CSX had the highest ex-intermodal growth at +9.5% YoY (UNP +4.5%, NSC +1.3%).
Total Canadian carload growth was +4.3% YoY in week 43 versus +4.8% in week 42.
CN carloads grew +3.5% YoY in week 43 (vs +3.8%), with intermodal at -0.2% (vs +0.1%) and ex-intermodal at +6.0% (vs +6.5%).
CPKC carloads grew +5.3% YoY in week 43 (vs +6.0%), with intermodal at +7.9% (vs +9.3%) and ex-intermodal at +3.6% (vs +4.0%).
4Q26 quarter-to-date, US Class I carload growth is tracking at +7.4% YoY, with intermodal +11% and ex-intermodal +3.7%.
4Q26 quarter-to-date, combined CPKC/CN carloads are tracking at +2.2% YoY, with intermodal +1.7% and ex-intermodal +2.5%.
UNP has the strongest US quarter-to-date total carload growth at +10.3% YoY, versus NSC +6.4% and CSX +4.8%.
